C or U: › [ C or U ] the first letter of the English alphabet
› [ C or U ] a note in Western music
› [ C or U ] a mark in an exam or for a piece of work that shows that your work is considered excellent

example: This concerto is in the key of A major.
這首協奏曲是 A 大調。
Sophie got an A for English.
She got straight As (= all her marks were As) in her final exams.
她期末考試各科成績均為 A。
Jim is a straight-A student (= all his marks are A).
